clips.title: The story
paras: In southern Darkshore, Kerlonian Evershade keeps a horn close at hand. It rouses him whenever sleep overtakes him on the road to Ashenvale.

Kerlonian Evershade has only recently awakened from centuries in the Emerald Dream, and wakefulness still weighs on him. The Druid of the Claw travels south toward Maestra's Post and entrusts the horn to travelers willing to escort him. When exhaustion takes him along the wilderness trail, a clear blast jolts him awake and gets him back on his feet before wild beasts or cultists can reach him.
